summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine monthly return submitted to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange regarding movements in authorized share capital and issued shares for May 2026. The filing details a transfer of 11,085,917 Class A shares from issued to treasury, with no change in total issued shares. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, shareholder activism, or other special situation is present. This is a standard regulatory disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
